requirement.comment: Read requirementDiagram with a lowercase requirement prefix and a case-insensitive Diagram suffix, ending at a word boundary. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and requirement.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read a direction line containing TB and its surrounding text. Unindented accessibility forms have priority; indentation instead permits the direction-line reading. Directives join text fragments without supplying the direction value, and separator-led common comments stop text and padding. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context and common.md#comment-lines.

Read a direction line containing BT and its surrounding text. Unindented accessibility forms have priority; indentation instead permits the direction-line reading. Directives join text fragments without supplying the direction value, and separator-led common comments stop text and padding. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context and common.md#comment-lines.

Read a direction line containing RL and its surrounding text. Unindented accessibility forms have priority; indentation instead permits the direction-line reading. Directives join text fragments without supplying the direction value, and separator-led common comments stop text and padding. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context and common.md#comment-lines.

Read a direction line containing LR and its surrounding text. Unindented accessibility forms have priority; indentation instead permits the direction-line reading. Directives join text fragments without supplying the direction value, and separator-led common comments stop text and padding. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context and common.md#comment-lines.

Read a case-folded accDescr keyword and its brace-delimited description, allowing Notation whitespace and directives before the opener. A closing brace ends the block without nesting; a separator-led common comment interrupts its text. At a statement-context unit position it can follow a closed string; enclosing names and line values still own block-shaped text. Follows requirement.md#accessibility-values, common.md#comment-lines, and requirement.md#empty-description-blocks.
Description block text runs to the first closing brace; quotes are ordinary text. A common comment is trivia in every context. Follows requirement.md#accessibility-values and common.md#comment-lines.

Read case-folded accTitle or accDescr with a colon and a line value. Padding admits directives and Notation whitespace, inline percent pairs remain text, and separator-led common comments end value runs. Follows requirement.md#accessibility-values and common.md#comment-lines.

Bounded style, classDef and class enter a context lasting through the line feed, where ASCII word characters and strings are values, and colon, comma, semicolon, dash and hash have style-unit meanings. Value scopes and text runs end before a separator-led common comment; the enclosing context reads that comment independently. The keyword boundary reads through following directives. Follows requirement.md#the-style-context.

patterns.name: variable.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a style target or style class name. Follows requirement.md#styles-and-classes.
Read a property name before a style colon. Follows requirement.md#styles-and-classes.
Read one whole style property value, leaving trailing whitespace outside its scope. Follows requirement.md#styles-and-classes.
Read a whole style without a property colon as one value, leaving trailing whitespace outside it. Follows requirement.md#styles-and-classes.

Read class application names in the style context. After a quoted final class, an empty description block returns to the statement context. Follows requirement.md#styles-and-classes, and requirement.md#empty-description-blocks.

patterns.name: variable.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a target or style class name. Follows requirement.md#styles-and-classes.
Read a relation name between its arrow parts. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arrow.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the bounded requirement, functionalRequirement, interfaceRequirement, performanceRequirement, physicalRequirement, designConstraint and element keywords case-insensitively. The boundary is judged after following directives. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context.
patterns.name: keyword.control.mermaid

patterns.comment: Double quotes enclose text other than double quotes, without escapes; an empty string is rejected. Follows requirement.md#units-and-contexts.
A relationship is name, dash, relation, right arrow, name; or name, left arrow, relation, dash, name; whitespace is optional. Follows requirement.md#relationships.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arrow.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a triple colon introducing style-class names on a definition or class shorthand. Follows requirement.md#requirements.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.class.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read opening and closing braces as definition delimiters and a colon as a field separator. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context.

An ASCII word character starts unquoted text that takes as many characters as possible other than colon, comma, line feed, opening brace, angle brackets, dash and equals; keyword-like words, quotes, hash, percent and closing braces inside it remain text. Value scopes and text runs end before a separator-led common comment; the enclosing context reads that comment independently. Follows requirement.md#units-and-contexts and common.md#comment-lines.

requirement-comma.comment: Read a comma separating style items or class names. Follows requirement.md#the-style-context and requirement.md#styles-and-classes.
requirement-comma.name: keyword.operator.separator.comma.mermaid

requirement-direction-text.comment: Read the nonblank ignored text around a direction while retaining directives. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context.

patterns.name: comment.block.ignored.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a nonblank direction-text unit. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context.

requirement-type-field.comment: Read an element's type field as a keyword, colon and text or string value. Follows requirement.md#elements.

patterns.comment: Read the element field value as retained text. Follows requirement.md#elements.

requirement-field.comment: Read a field key and its value. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context and requirement.md#units-and-contexts.

patterns.comment: Read the field's unquoted text value. Follows requirement.md#units-and-contexts.

requirement-body.comment: Read a requirement or element body, keeping its empty description blocks as ignored text. Follows requirement.md#requirements.

patterns.name: comment.block.ignored.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read an empty description block in a body as an ignored item. Follows requirement.md#empty-description-blocks.
Read the complete fixed-value field so a following empty block remains an ignored body item. Follows requirement.md#requirements.

requirement-comments.comment: At a unit start in the statement context a hash or percent begins a comment through the physical line end; neither starts a comment inside unquoted text, a string or style context. Directives in comment text are read whole. Value scopes and text runs end before a separator-led common comment; the enclosing context reads that comment independently. Follows requirement.md#comments.

patterns.name: comment.line.number-sign.mermaid
patterns.comment: A hash starts a native comment; makes separator-led common comments independent trivia. Follows requirement.md#comments.

patterns.name: comment.line.percentage.mermaid
patterns.comment: A percent starts a native comment; reads directives in its body whole. Neither character of a percent pair belongs to a directive; a lone text percent before a directive keeps the single-percent mark. Follows requirement.md#comments.

requirement-field-value.comment: Read the common parts of field values before the field-specific unquoted text. Follows requirement.md#units-and-contexts.

patterns.name: constant.language.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a listed risk or verification method. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context.

requirement-field-header.comment: Read the field keyword, its colon and their directive-bearing gaps once for text and type fields. Follows requirement.md#the-statement-context.

requirement-line-final-keywords.comment: Read a reserved keyword at a statement start when only padding and directives follow on its physical line. A value on a later line receives the surrounding context's scopes. Follows requirement.md#accessibility-values and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
